description_en: Apartment for sale in an existing building in Laprake. The apartment has an area of ​​108.2 m2 and is organized by the corridor that divides the living room and the kitchen, the 3 bedrooms as well as the dining room and the toilet. Orientation is east and west. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation. For any information or visit to the property, contact me!
